sources.notes: Found and read on 10 November 2026 by the sources agent. The Main City Calendar answered 200 with 124 VEVENTs from 11 November 2026 to December 2030, 9 in the next 30 days: six council, planning and urban-renewal meetings (one cancelled), two office closures and one public event, the Carbon Valley Holiday Festival (5 December, 4 to 6 pm; the feed gives only "Dacono CO 80514" for the place, and Firestone's calendar lists the same festival at Miners Park from noon, so the venue needs checking). Meetings and closures are excluded by title, a first pass for the editor. The Music and Spirits Festival calendar was empty (the festival is in August; a search result gave 1 August 2026 at Centennial Field) and the Police calendar held 3 items for 2027 (National Law Enforcement Day, two Drug Take Back Days). The site's robots.txt (CivicPlus's standard file, read 10 November 2026) disallows /common/modules/icalendar/, /calendar.aspx and /RSSFeed.aspx for every agent, as it has on every CivicPlus site since 20-21 October, so under robots: honor ingest will not read this; it is the feed the site offers residents as a calendar subscription, and robots: subscribe is the editor's call, as it was for frederickco-gov. Expect one or two public events a month at most; the value is that the City's own festivals and take-back days arrive without a hand read. robots: subscribe from 10 November 2026, the owner's call: the host's robots.txt disallows the path, and this is the calendar the organization publishes for subscription; one weekly read is what a subscribed calendar does (DECISIONS.md, "The owner subscribes to the calendar feeds").

The iCal reaches further than the CivicPlus RSS (RSSFeed.aspx?ModID=58&CID=34, 1 item, current month only). The Town's signature events (Miners Day in September, Frederick in Flight in June, Chainsaws & Chuckwagons in July, Music in the Park on summer second Wednesdays, the Memorial Day ceremony) each have a page under /234/Events and reach the calendar only as the date nears, so the events page is read by hand as well. www.frederickco.gov/robots.txt is a Cloudflare content-signals stub with no rules; frederickco.gov's (CivicPlus) disallows /RSS.aspx and /CurrentEvents*.aspx, neither of which this reads. America/Denver times. Confirmed 5 October 2026 on the owner's word that the choice was the editor's. robots: subscribe from 29 October 2026, the editor's call delegated by the owner: CivicPlus added `Disallow: /common/modules/icalendar/` to every site it hosts on 20-21 October, which the check now reads case-blind, and this feed is the one the site offers residents as a calendar subscription; one nightly read is what a subscribed calendar does (DECISIONS.md, "CivicPlus's calendar feeds"). Found and read on 2 November 2026 by the Frederick build agent for the Frederick flagship build: the catID=34 feed carried one item, Festival of Lights (UID 4287, 5 December, all-day in the feed); the event page now gives 5:30 to 8 pm, and the listing was updated. The Events page (/234/Events) lists the 2026 season's seven Town events, all past but the Festival, and links the Frederick Market (four market dates a year), Music in the Park and the Memorial Day ceremony. The Town's news feed (/civicalerts.aspx) is registered separately below. The museum's first-Friday openings (6 November, 4 December) come from /717, not the feed.

sources.name: Town of Frederick: Frederick Meetings Calendar
sources.notes: Found and read once on 5 October 2026. The two titles excluded are the calendar's own placeholders ("One Time Event" on 31 December 2030, "Parking Lot for Agenda Items" on 30 December 2027), not meetings. Under the event standard (docs/archive/AUDIT-2026-10-02.md) routine meetings are not events; whether to confirm this feed at all, or exclude the regular sessions as Longmont's registry does, is the editor's call. The Town's nine other iCal categories (Centennial Park, Crist Park, Frederick Recreation Area, Downtown Activities, each board on its own) were each read once and are empty. Left proposed 5 October 2026: every item is a routine meeting, which the event standard excludes; confirm it only to have the meetings staged. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (an official Town calendar). Its routine board and commission meetings are excluded by title under the event standard, as Firestone’s and Dacono’s are, so it stages only what is not a regular meeting; remove an exclusion to have that body’s meetings staged. robots: subscribe from 29 October 2026, the editor's call delegated by the owner: CivicPlus added `Disallow: /common/modules/icalendar/` to every site it hosts on 20-21 October, which the check now reads case-blind, and this feed is the one the site offers residents as a calendar subscription; one nightly read is what a subscribed calendar does (DECISIONS.md, "CivicPlus's calendar feeds"). Read 2 November 2026 by the Frederick build agent: 42 items from 2 November to 28 February, every one a board, commission or committee meeting (the Board's work sessions of 18 November and 16 December and the Urban Renewal Authority's 18 November meeting marked Canceled-) except the two developer neighborhood meetings on Teams (UIDs 4404 and 4405, already staged; left there, since the feed's LOCATION is a Teams join block). The Youth Commission meets second Saturdays 9 to 10 am; used for the Youth Commission program's schedule line.

sources.name: Carbon Valley Regional Library (High Plains Library District), LibCal
sources.notes: Found and read once on 5 October 2026. One branch serves all three towns: 7 Park Avenue, Firestone (Mon to Thu 9 am to 8 pm, Fri and Sat 10 am to 5 pm, Sun 1 to 5 pm, per mylibrary.us/locations-and-hours/). The district's LibCal is the same one the Windsor and Johnstown work found: its public iCal (ical_subscribe.php?src=p&cid=8181) is the district's 500 oldest items, 4 August to 25 September 2026 on 5 October, and no parameter (cal, cm, inc, d, t) narrows it to the branch or moves it forward, re-tested three ways. The district-wide RSS (rss.php?iid=4057&m=month&cid=8181; m=upcoming answers "invalid mode") does carry the coming fortnight, 300 items on 5 October of which 19 were at the Carbon Valley Regional Library (Drop-in Chess, English Class, Tween Craft Club, Sketch Club, Page Turner's Book Club), but its dates, times and building are inside each item's description, which the repo's RSS reader does not read (it reads CivicPlus's calendarEvent elements), so ingest would stage nothing from it: reading LibCal RSS would be a new feed reader, which is a feature to ask about. Until then the branch's calendar page, linked above with the building preselected, is read in a browser. robots.txt names a 10-second crawl delay for everyone and disallows the /process_ endpoints the page loads events from, so the page cannot be read by script either. The locationFilter is set for the day a reader exists. Confirmed 5 October 2026 on the owner's word that the choice was the editor's. Read as RSS from 5 October 2026: scripts/lib/feeds/rss.ts now reads LibCal's own libcal:date, libcal:time, libcal:location and libcal:campus elements (the district-wide feed covers the coming fortnight or so, 300 items on 5 October), and the locationFilter keeps the branch's. Exclusions set 5 October 2026 from the event standard in docs/archive/AUDIT-2026-10-02.md (routine meetings, the court and office closures are not events), at the owner's direction that the sources be settled on the editor's judgment; remove any to have it staged again. Storytimes, clubs, drop-ins, the English class and the advisory board are excluded; what remains is the one-off programs (a science afternoon, a teen improv session, an adult D&D one-shot, a 3D-modelling class). The feed marks a called-off session by prefixing "Cancelled:" to the title, as Longmont's does. The branch is in Firestone, so staged items carry subTown firestone. Excluded on 5 October 2026 at the review: "Let’s Draw!" and "Science Fun", monthly after-school sessions for elementary pupils (a class in all but name, under the event standard). "Ageless Grace" was already excluded; its cancelled session reached staging because the feed wrote a non-breaking space in the title, which the readers now treat as a space. Feed narrowed on 5 October 2026 to the branch with cam=4554 (the calendar's own building filter): 62 items, all at Carbon Valley, reaching about a month ahead where the district feed's 300 reach a fortnight. The locationFilter stays as a guard. Further exclusions on 5 October 2026, with the branch feed: the baby storytime (Twinkle Babies), the job-help drop-in, the legal clinic, Library 101, the monthly Paws to Read, make-and-take craft classes (Cricut, tote bags, looming), as Longmont excludes them, and the bird walk at Golden Ponds, which is in Longmont. Moved to the Frederick guide on 2 November 2026 when Carbon Valley closed: the branch is at 7 Park Avenue in Firestone and is the Frederick area's library (High Plains Library District), so its programs are listed where a Frederick family would look for them. Read 2 November 2026 by the Frederick build agent: the branch RSS (cam=4554) carried about 70 items from 1 November to 1 December; the d= parameter does not move it forward and the month page loads by script, so December is unread until the feed reaches it. Published from it as events: the one-offs (Decorative Mandala Tote Bag 4 November, Medieval Garb Workshop 7 November, Bubble Tea Social 16 November, Create with Canva 18 November, Adult D&D one-shot 28 November), the monthly evening Wiggle Worms yoga storytime (10 November, 8 December), Teen D&D (3 November, 1 December) and Science Fun (12 November, 10 December); the storytimes, clubs, book groups, Paws to Read, LEGO Club, Let's Draw!, the quilters, the genealogy drop-in and the English class are programs on the Families and Get involved pages. Many LibCal event pages carry a boilerplate 'this is an online event' note under an in-person title and room; the listings say so.

sources.name: Eventbrite, events in Frederick, Firestone, Dacono
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026, when the owner asked for a way to use Eventbrite. The place page is Eventbrite's search of the region around Frederick, not of the town: 49 pages of twenty. The reader (scripts/lib/feeds/eventbrite.ts) takes the first five pages, one every two seconds, and the location filter keeps what is in Frederick, Firestone, Dacono. Read that day: 90 events in five pages, 3 of them in town: Colorado Ghosts & Vampire Tours - Under 18 years old Free with Gaurdian (2026-11-14, Meco Coffee Collection); Dec 3 Broker Education: NEW vs RESALE - 2 CE Credits (2026-12-03, Red Barn Meadows by Century Communities); Holiday Princess Tea & Concert (2026-12-12, Magical Moments). Eventbrite lists every organizer's events, so this is filed as other and its items wait for a person; classes and workshops are most of what a small town shows. robots.txt at www.eventbrite.com allows the page for ordinary agents (it disallows its internal /api/v3/destination/ search, which the reader does not use). Eventbrite's terms of service restrict automated collection of its pages; confirming this source is the owner's decision with that in mind. The event search API was shut in 2020, and the API that remains lists only the token holder's own events. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("for all towns as well use eventbrite"), told that Eventbrite's terms restrict automated collection and that robots.txt allows the page. Still filed as other: its items wait for a person. autoApprove from 10 November 2026, the owner's word ("auto publish all; having to manually do it would defeat the purpose of the town network setup"): its items publish under the standing rules, and one that may be an event already on the guide at that hour still waits. The title exclusions were widened the same day to what the guide never lists: professional trainings and association socials, partisan events, sales demonstrations, clinics' own workshops, app-run scavenger hunts and events in a private home.
